tasks.description: TEMPORARY GPT-5.5 SOLO SELF-REVIEW / BOUNDED H15 INITIALIZATION-BASIN TRIAGE AFTER T-C2 GATE FAILURE. The T-C2 wrapper produced five solver calls on opened development source242 and failed the local task gate only because the deliberately noncanonical H15_goal_facing production cell returned Infeasible_Problem_Detected. Canonical H15, H12 and H35 all converged with full objective reconstruction relative errors below 1e-6 and no converged hard defect. The failed H15_goal_facing cell nevertheless had direct/full objective reconstruction relative error about 1.7e-16 and a large epsilon/slack penalty, so the next question is whether the nonconvergence is caused by an overly aggressive noncanonical initialization basin rather than by the repaired objective or source242 setup. Implement/run a narrowly scoped diagnostic on the same opened development source242, H15, V15_shared problem only: read and preserve the prior T-C2 raw evidence; verify a post-T-C2 external backup before consuming solver calls; then solve at most three H15 production cells initialized by convex blends between the prior canonical zero-control initialization and the prior goal-facing initialization, with frozen alpha values [0.25, 0.50, 0.75]. Do not rerun alpha=0 or alpha=1 as new solver calls; use prior T-C2 results as anchors. For each new cell report initialization hash, readback counts, solver status/iterations, objective value, full and no-epsilon reconstruction errors, epsilon vector labels/dimensions/nonzero counts/weighted sums, direct NLP f/g checks, constraint/bound residuals, solver wall time and whole-decision get_action timing. Stop after three solver calls or immediately if setup becomes inert or a converged cell exceeds the hard-defect relative-error threshold. No plant rollout, no training/refit, no validation64, no sealed/final test, no new infrastructure. This is development evidence only and cannot establish reproduction success.
tasks.method: three-solve H15 initialization-basin triage using convex blends alpha=[0.25,0.50,0.75] between the already observed canonical-success and goal-facing-infeasible initial primals, with objective/epsilon/direct-NLP/timing readback

config_constraints.diagnostic_reason: T-C2 failed because H15_goal_facing was nonconverged while canonical production cells passed objective reconstruction; test initialization basin sensitivity before larger control/training work.
